title: Create a progressive homework task
description: Build stages from supported practice to independent application.
accomplishes: Build stages from supported practice to independent application. Include instructions, required materials, optional hints and review criteria. Keep workload realistic and do not rely on inaccessible resources or assume every learner has the same support at home.
prompt:
Act as an instructional designer.

Task: Create a progressive homework task.

Input context:
- TOPIC: [TOPIC]
- LEVEL: [LEVEL]
- OBJECTIVES: [OBJECTIVES]
- TIME LIMIT: [TIME LIMIT]

Build stages from supported practice to independent application. Include instructions, required materials, optional hints and review criteria. Keep workload realistic and do not rely on inaccessible resources or assume every learner has the same support at home.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Spreadsheet homework
First identify a column type, then correct one supplied formula and finally explain a similar formula independently. Offer hints separately and provide a non-software alternative when needed. State expected effort and submission format. The task should reveal reasoning, not only a copied answer; it has not been assigned or assessed in this example.
